daily mean salinity

# initialize list to collect all outputs
all_sites_list <- list()
variables <- c("so", "thetao")#surface salinity and temperature


for (i in 1:nrow(stations_df)) {
  site_name <- stations_df$site[i]
  coords <- stations_df[i, c("lon", "lat"), drop = FALSE]
  raster_path <- stations_df$raster_path[i]
  
  site_data_long <- data.frame()  # To store long-format records per variable
  
  for (var in variables) {
    # Load the raster brick for the variable
    r_brick <- brick(raster_path, varname = var)
    layer_dates <- as.Date(gsub("X", "", names(r_brick)), format = "%Y.%m.%d")
    summer_indices <- which(months(layer_dates) %in% month.name[6:10])#june to october
    
    # Extract data
    extracted <- terra::extract(x = r_brick, y = coords)
    summer_data <- extracted[, summer_indices, drop = TRUE]  # Ensure it's a vector
    
    # Build a tidy (long format) data frame
    var_df <- data.frame(
      site = site_name,
      variable = var,
      date = layer_dates[summer_indices],
      value = as.numeric(summer_data)
    )
    
    site_data_long <- rbind(site_data_long, var_df)
  }
  
  all_sites_list[[i]] <- site_data_long
}

# Combine all into one tidy long-format data frame
final_output <- do.call(rbind, all_sites_list)

final_wide <- final_output %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(site, date),
    names_from = variable,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  arrange(site, date)

final_wide$site <- factor(final_wide$site, 
                          levels = c("WH", "SK", "BOK", "KB03", "SW08", "H21","BB23",
                                     "BB36", "GDY", "GB96","LL17", "IU7", "FIN"))

final_filtered <- final_wide %>%
  filter(format(date, "%Y") >= "2003",
         format(date, "%Y") <= "2023")%>%
  mutate(year = year(date))

final_mean <- final_filtered %>%
  mutate(year = year(date))%>%
  group_by(site, year)%>%
  summarise(Mean = mean(so))
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'site'. You can override using the
## `.groups` argument.
my_colors2 <- c("#E37468","#D3906C","#E1C68C","#EBDB98","#D7E0B1","#BFCEB2","#99AEB7","#839CBA","#708EBF","#5E7FC2","#4666AB","#3A5696","#283C6B")

ggplot(final_mean, aes(x = year, y = Mean, group = site, color = site))+
  geom_line(linewidth = 1)+
  theme_light(base_size = 12)+
  scale_color_manual(values = my_colors2)+
  ylab("Mean Salinity [PSU]") + xlab("Year")

#ggsave("Supplemental_Salinity.pdf", dpi = 300, width = 18.2, height = 10, units = "cm")

#extract surface salinity in sampling year + 5 years before

final_2023 <- final_wide %>%
  filter(format(date, "%Y") >= "2018",
         format(date, "%Y") <= "2023")%>%
  filter(site %in% c("BOK", "SW08", "H21", "BB23", "GDY", "LL17", "IU7"))

final_2022 <- final_wide %>%
  filter(format(date, "%Y") >= "2017",
         format(date, "%Y") <= "2022")%>%
  filter(site %in% c("WH", "SK", "KB03", "SW08", "BB36", "GB96"))

final_2018 <- final_wide %>%
  filter(format(date, "%Y") >= "2013",
         format(date, "%Y") <= "2018")%>%
  filter(site == "FIN")

final_5yrs <- dplyr::bind_rows(list("2023"= final_2023, "2022"=final_2022, "2018"=final_2018), .id = 'sampling_year')

ggplot(final_5yrs, aes(x = site, y = so, fill = site, col = site)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 1) +
  theme_light(base_size = 14)+

  xlab("Sampling location")+
  ylab("Salinity [PSU]")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors2)+
  scale_color_manual(values = my_colors2)+
  stat_summary(fun = "mean",
               geom = "point",
               color = "black",
               alpha = 0.6)+
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size = 10))

future salinity and habitat viability

use mean LS5 at 24 hours

this means that if salinity is below this threshold for a day, 5% of pop will die

survival contemporary is mean of all measured populations

adaptive survival contemporary is mean of best finish population

#these files are really big, skip below to load processed file directly
#load daily salinity data 
raster_path <- "cmems_mod_glo_phy_my_0.083deg_P1D-m_1769159187216.nc" #2020-2025

#process files
r_brick <- brick(raster_path, varname = "so")

r_df <- raster::as.data.frame(r_brick, xy = TRUE)

# Reshape the data to a long format
r_df_long <- r_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(x, y), names_to = "time", values_to = "salinity")

r_df_long$time <- as.Date(gsub("X", "", r_df_long$time), format="%Y.%m.%d")

r_df_long <- r_df_long %>%
  mutate(month = month(time))%>%
  mutate(day = day(time))%>%
  filter(month >= 6,
         month <= 10)%>%
  mutate(year = year(time))%>%
  filter(year != 2025)%>%#exclude 2025 since data was not complete
  group_by(x, y, month, day) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_salinity = mean(salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

#try applying salinity change to daily measurements
#convert into sf objects and merge by nearest feature
diff_sf <- st_as_sf(
  r_df_diff,
  coords = c("x", "y"),
  crs = 4326
)

long_sf <- st_as_sf(
  r_df_long,
  coords = c("x", "y"),
  crs = 4326
)

long_with_diff <- st_join(
  long_sf,
  diff_sf,
  join = st_nearest_feature
)

nearest_id <- st_nearest_feature(long_sf, diff_sf)

distances <- st_distance(long_sf, diff_sf[nearest_id, ], by_element = TRUE)

summary(as.numeric(distances))

#nearest_join has some missasignments -->  remove 


df <- long_with_diff %>%
  mutate(
    x = sf::st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1],
    y = sf::st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2]
  ) %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry()%>%
  dplyr::select(
    x, y,
    month, day,
    mean_salinity,
    salinity_diff)

df$future_sal <- df$mean_salinity + df$salinity_diff

df <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(salinity_diff))

#fwrite(df, "Daily_salinity_RCP85_BioOracle-Copernicus.csv")

r_df_days <- df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(x,y) %>%
  summarise(
    days_below_so = sum(mean_salinity < 5.0, na.rm = TRUE),#LS5 5.0 with glmer 24h
    days_below_so_fb = sum(mean_salinity < 1.7, na.rm = TRUE),#LS5  1.7 with glmer 24h (2.2 is upper CI)
    days_below_so_adj_95 = sum(future_sal < 5.0, na.rm = TRUE),
    days_below_so_adj_95fb = sum(future_sal < 1.7, na.rm = TRUE),
    days_total = sum(mean_salinity > -1, na.rm = TRUE),#-1 to include all possible days
    .groups = "drop")%>%
  filter(days_total == 153)%>%
  mutate(survival_so = (1-(days_below_so/days_total))*100)%>%#calculate percentages
  mutate(survival_adj_95 = (1-(days_below_so_adj_95/days_total))*100)%>%
  mutate(survival_so_fb = (1-(days_below_so_fb/days_total))*100)%>%
  mutate(survival_adj_95fb = (1-(days_below_so_adj_95fb/days_total))*100)

fwrite(r_df_days, "Habitat_suitability_RCP85_BioOracle-Copernicus.csv")
